name: Portland

stay_areas.name: Museum district
stay_areas.best_for: Culture-first visitors near the Portland Art Museum and Ladd Carriage House
stay_areas.why: The downtown blocks around the Portland Art Museum knit the Oregon Jewish Museum, Ladd Carriage House, and The Old Church into one walkable cluster.

stay_areas.name: West hills
stay_areas.best_for: Guests who want the Pittock Mansion overlook and an easy run to the Oregon Zoo
stay_areas.why: Forested slopes below the Pittock Mansion give hillside views and the shortest reach to the Oregon Zoo in the west hills.

stay_areas.name: East riverbank
stay_areas.best_for: Train-minded travellers near the Oregon Rail Heritage Center
stay_areas.why: The eastern riverside blocks around the Oregon Rail Heritage Center pair working locomotives with a quieter stay across the water from downtown.
